before_times: who the session is for: the booker's child, or the booker (an adult student)
the subject and the course, like Algebra 1
the next test or deadline (a date, optional)
new or returning (a new student gets the free first meeting first)
where: at the center, by video, or at home
after_time: a textbook or worksheets, and will the student bring class notes
for a home session: the address, a quiet table, and which adult will be home
secure_page_only: the parent or guardian is 18 or older
the student's age, grade and school
how the student learns best (an IEP, a 504 plan, extra time), optional
for a home session: the adult (18 or older) who stays home for the whole session
intake_questions.never_asked: grades, report cards or school records
intake_questions.who_may_book: a parent or guardian for a student under 18 (texts go to the parent only); an adult student for themselves; a student under 18 alone gets a link to pass to a parent (the age of adulthood comes from the state form)

stop.words: a student or parent writes about self-harm
stop.say: Call or text 988 now. If anyone is in danger right now, call 911.
stop.booking: no booking until they ask again

stop.words: someone is in danger right now

go_on.words: a parent says the student is very worried about a test
go_on.what: the booking goes on; Rosie gives no advice, and the tutor is told privately on the student's page

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Free first meeting
steps.when: at least 1 day before a new student's first session
steps.who: a new student and a parent
steps.result: the tutor saves the goals and a short skills check on the student's page; the first session stands, or moves to another tutor or subject with no fee

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: bring class notes, the textbook or worksheets, a calculator, and the next test date; for video: a quiet spot, a laptop or tablet with a camera, and paper

staff.skills: subjects and grade levels for each tutor (the example: Hannah, math and SAT; Marcus, science and math; Isaac, SAT and ACT, college essays and science; Nina, reading, writing, college essays and SAT prep)
staff.supervision: a tutor in training works only alongside a lead tutor (the owner's setting)
staff.who_oks: Sam matches every new student with a tutor, and OKs prices over $500
staff.stand_in: a stand-in teaches the same subject and level, and gets the student's private notes and the last progress note

children_and_age.who_may_book: a parent or guardian for a student under 18 (texts go to the parent only); an adult student for themselves; a student under 18 alone gets a link to pass to a parent (the age of adulthood comes from the state form)
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts, video links and progress notes for a student under 18 go only to the parent or guardian; Rosie keeps no phone number for a child
children_and_age.minors_rules: the age a student may book alone, from the state form

visit.check_in: at the center: the parent gives the check-in code at the front desk when dropping the student off; by video: the code is read out at the start, with the parent there; at home: the adult at home gives the code at the door
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the tutor; then a progress note for the parent by private link: what was covered, what went well, what to practice, the next step
visit.changes_at_visit: 15 more minutes at the center ($20), or 30 more minutes at home ($45), is priced and OK'd by the parent before it's added
visit.before_work: the tutor reads the student's private notes (any learning needs) on the signed-in phone, never in a text

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: usually none: tutoring and music lessons are treated as needing no state license (a switch: the state's form can still name one, like a business registration)
license.who: the business: its registration, where the state gave one; each tutor who teaches students under 18: a background check, where the state's rules require one
license.ask: the business registration number; for each tutor who teaches students under 18, who ran the background check, what it covered, and its date
license.insurance: liability insurance shows only once the owner sends proof

never_in_a_text: a student's learning needs (an IEP, a 504 plan, a diagnosis), grade, school and progress notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and private links
